CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_latest_group_messages(group_ids bigint[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, group_id bigint, content text, created_at timestamp with time zone, seen_at timestamp with time zone, media text[], sent_by bigint, sender_first_name text, sender_last_name text, sender_avatar text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  return query
  select distinct on (cm.group)
    cm.id,
    cm.group,
    cm.content,
    cm.created_at,
    cm.seen_at,
    cm.media,
    cm.sent_by,
    u.first_name,
    u.last_name,
    u.avatar
  from chat_messages cm
  join users u on cm.sent_by = u.id
  where cm.group = any(group_ids)
  order by cm.group, cm.created_at desc;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_user_program_inductions()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  existing_inductions json[];  -- Declare as JSON array
  new_chat_id BIGINT;
  new_form_id BIGINT;
  client_user_id BIGINT;
BEGIN
  -- 1) Get the inductions from the programs row (as json[])
  SELECT p.inductions 
    INTO existing_inductions
    FROM programs p
   WHERE p.id = NEW.program_id;

  -- If inductions is NULL or empty, then skip
  IF existing_inductions IS NULL OR array_length(existing_inductions, 1) IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- 2) Get the actual user_id from the profiles table
  SELECT pr.user_id
    INTO client_user_id
    FROM profiles pr
   WHERE pr.id = NEW.client_id
   LIMIT 1;

  IF client_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- 3) Create a new chat_message record for this user_program
  INSERT INTO chat_messages (user_program, sent_by)
       VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.trainer_id)
    RETURNING id INTO new_chat_id;

  -- 4) Create a new forms record referencing the new chat_message and using the inductions value
  INSERT INTO forms (message_id, program_id, questions, status, trainer_id, client_id, type)
       VALUES (
         new_chat_id,
         NEW.program_id,
         existing_inductions,  -- Note: this is a json[] value
         'pending',
         NEW.trainer_id,
         client_user_id,
         'induction'
       )
    RETURNING id INTO new_form_id;

  -- 5) Update the chat_message record with the forms id
  UPDATE chat_messages
     SET form = new_form_id
   WHERE id = new_chat_id;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.name: handle_user_program_inductions

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.json_merge(json1 json, json2 json)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  result JSON;
BEGIN
  SELECT json_object_agg(key, value)
  INTO result
  FROM (
    SELECT key, value FROM json_each(json1)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT key, value FROM json_each(json2)
  ) AS kv;
  RETURN result;
END;
$function$
functions.name: json_merge

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_documents(query_vector vector, match_count integer DEFAULT 5, filter jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, content text, metadata jsonb, embedding vector, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      d.id,
      d.content,
      d.metadata,
      d.embedding,
      1 - (d.embedding <=> query_vector) AS similarity
    FROM ai_vectors d
    WHERE filter IS NULL OR d.metadata @> filter
    ORDER BY d.embedding <=> query_vector
    LIMIT match_count;
END;
$function$
functions.name: match_documents
functions.result: TABLE(id bigint, content text, metadata jsonb, embedding vector, similarity double precision)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_program_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
    v_user_id bigint;   -- <-- bigint now
begin
    select p.user_id
      into v_user_id
      from public.profiles p
     where p.id = new.client_id;   -- bigint = bigint

    if v_user_id is null then
        raise warning 'No user_id found for client_id %', new.client_id;
        return new;
    end if;

    insert into public.notifications (user_id, title, body, created_at)
    values (
        v_user_id,
        'Your workout plan has been updated.',
        'Open the app to see your new exercises and schedule 💪',
        now()
    );

    return new;
end;
$function$
functions.name: notify_program_update

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_ai_documents(query_embedding vector, match_count integer, filter json DEFAULT NULL::json)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, content text, chatbot_id uuid, metadata json, embedding vector, similarity numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    d.id,
    d.content,
    d.chatbot_id,
    d.metadata,
    d.embedding,
    1 - (d.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
  FROM documents d
  WHERE
    (filter IS NULL OR d.metadata ->> 'chatbot_id' = filter ->> 'chatbot_id')
  ORDER BY similarity DESC
  LIMIT match_count;
END;$function$
functions.name: search_ai_documents

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_ai_documents(query_embedding vector, match_count integer DEFAULT 5, filter jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, content text, metadata jsonb, embedding jsonb, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    ai_vectors.id,
    ai_vectors.content,
    ai_vectors.metadata,
    (ai_vectors.embedding::text)::jsonb as embedding,
    1 - (ai_vectors.embedding <=> query_embedding) as similarity
  FROM ai_vectors
  WHERE
    ai_vectors.metadata @> filter   -- apply metadata filter if provided
  ORDER BY ai_vectors.embedding <=> query_embedding DESC
  LIMIT match_count;
END;
$function$

functions.result: TABLE(id bigint, content text, metadata jsonb, embedding jsonb, similarity double precision)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public."update Equipment Required"()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$DECLARE
    v_equipment_list TEXT[];
BEGIN
    -- Extract unique equipment from all exercises in the new workouts JSON array (avoiding "" due to backslash errors)
    SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT REPLACE(eq::TEXT, '"', '')) INTO v_equipment_list
    FROM (
        SELECT (json_array_elements(e->'equipment'))::TEXT AS eq
        FROM unnest(NEW.workouts) AS w_json, 
             json_array_elements(w_json->'exercises') e
    ) subquery;

    -- Set the new value before update (to prevent recursion)
    NEW.equipment_required := v_equipment_list;

    RETURN NEW;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_average_ratings()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$DECLARE
  avg_trainer_rating numeric(10,2);
  avg_program_rating numeric(10,2);
  target_trainer_id numeric;  -- adjust datatype if needed
  target_program_id numeric;  -- adjust datatype if needed
BEGIN
  -- Determine the trainer and program IDs from the new or old row.
  target_trainer_id := COALESCE(NEW.trainer, OLD.trainer);
  target_program_id := COALESCE(NEW.program, OLD.program);

  -- Calculate the new average rating for the trainer.
  SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(rating)::numeric, 2), 0)
    INTO avg_trainer_rating
    FROM reviews
    WHERE trainer = target_trainer_id;

  -- Update the trainer_profile table.
  UPDATE trainer_profile
    SET rating = avg_trainer_rating
    WHERE user_id = target_trainer_id;

  -- Calculate and update the program's overall rating, if applicable.
  IF target_program_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(rating)::numeric, 2), 0)
      INTO avg_program_rating
      FROM reviews
      WHERE program = target_program_id;

    UPDATE programs
      SET overall_rating = avg_program_rating
      WHERE id = target_program_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN NULL;  -- AFTER triggers must return null
END;$function$
functions.name: update_average_ratings

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_drills_from_template()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  -- Only run if the assessment_template is set
  if NEW.template is not null then
    update assessment
    set drills = (
      select drills
      from assessment_template
      where id = NEW.template
    )
    where id = NEW.id;
  end if;

  return NEW;
end;
$function$
